svg.title: Test one step on its own. Rerunning the whole research agent (request, search terms, web search, pick sources, write) after every change is slow, costly and noisy. Instead, pull out the web search step and check its result links: pass if at least 40 percent come from preferred sites such as arxiv.org and nature.com. In my run, a request for recent papers passed with 4 of 4 links, 100 percent, for papers from 1998 and 2006: the eval checks where links point, not how old the papers are, so the eval needs fixing.
